quote: Standardize the trace across all our types; brain (AIP-3) builds and maintains it.
means: Every type is traced the same way: its type doc says which events write its docs (what, in which step, by which kind of author), every doc shows the same trace, and AIP-3 (brain) builds it and keeps it, its check enforcing it.
